speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning. I see you've been dealing with fatigue, fever, and severe leg pain for three weeks; this combination is quite concerning in a child. To better understand what is happening, have you noticed any specific spots on your skin or gums that bleed easily?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Leukemia (likely Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia)

The combination of bone pain, fever, fatigue, and easy bruising is highly suggestive of leukemia. I would like to order a Complete Blood Count (CBC) with differential and a peripheral blood smear to look for blasts. REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential and peripheral smear.
